name: Differentiable Point-Based Radiance Fields
definition: A scene representation that models radiance with a point cloud augmented with local spherical harmonic coefficients per point, enabling efficient view synthesis via differentiable splat rendering.
summary: Differentiable Point-Based Radiance Fields is a fast, memory-efficient rendering method that replaces volumetric ray-marching with a differentiable splat-based rasterizer to achieve rapid view synthesis.
